policy: One new all-stage continuation: one direct/specification/plan/code target per update, rotating over the identical seed43 base-task schedule used by the original 512-update coder. Frozen route uses original planner for specification/plan and pinned previously trained replay coder for code and direct replies. No inference reference assistance except explicitly separate gold-code training probes.
limits: 96 correlated training cases; inspected regression validation and bilingual suite. Frozen route loads two checkpoints and reuses historical coder training, whereas unified all-stage replay loads one. Objective allocation, token exposure, memory and compute differ. No prompt/budget tuning on evaluation.
